_about: Habitat range maps (List 11 #102). A range record is a GENERATED build artefact — a reverse index over the #7 spawn tables joined to #29 ecology zones, projected onto #11 route-graph geography. It is never hand-authored and never stored in the save (#96 carries no range data). To change a range, change a row in its home table. Every cell carries a provenance pointer; a cell with no provenance does not render.
depths_rule: The Dark Forest depths have NO input rows (#7 depths table intentionally empty; #29 depths zone residents: []). The projection renders the depths as UNSURVEYED, never as confidently empty. Adding a depths row to any input table is a canon event; the map then changes by itself.

display_gates.in_game: #32 Mochiioteca map module reveal states over #11 nodes; species must be seen-or-beyond per #14 before a map hangs on its entry
display_gates.show_side: writers'-room print of the same projection; a location may only stage species its range record gives provenance for (#84 roster-binding, visual twin)

cells.qualifiers: { method, timeBands, residency } — carried from the source row, nulls preserved

record_shape.generatedFrom: { spawnTables: <version/hash>, ecologyTables: <version/hash> } — currency stamp so a stale map is detectable
record_shape.regionId: canon region id (display name via lookup — Region 1 displays as Iridescence)
